ja:ux.cloud.terms.siteIntro.text: 利用規約への同意が一度だけ必要です。murage.ai で同意してから、ここに戻ってください。
ja:ux.cloud.terms.siteIntro.en: You need to agree to the terms once. Agree on murage.ai, then come back here.

ja:ux.cloud.signin.notHere.text: {engine} には、まだブラウザからサインインできません。デスクトップ版の Murage アプリをお使いください。
ja:ux.cloud.signin.notHere.en: You can't sign in to {engine} from a browser yet. Use the Murage desktop app for it.

ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub.text: 毎朝、まずあなたの対応が必要なことを1ページにまとめます。カレンダーとメールは、接続していただいたら使います。
ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub.en: Each morning, I give you one short page of what needs your attention first. I use your calendar and email once you connect them.
ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub.note: Omits that the page is short and uses unnecessarily formal address. Fix: 毎朝、まず対応が必要なことを1ページに短くまとめて渡します。カレンダーとメールは、接続したら使います。

ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub.text: 今日の予定を1行ずつ入力してください。どれが間に合わなくなりそうか、何から始めるべきかをお伝えします。
ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub.en: Type in today's tasks, one per line. I tell you which task will run late and what to do first.
ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub.note: Changes 'will run late' to 'looks likely to miss the deadline'. Fix: 今日やることを1行に1つずつ入力してください。どれが遅れるか、何から始めればよいかを伝えます。

ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.sub.text: メモを貼り付けてください。次にやることを拾い出し、日付があるものや、相手が待っているものを先に並べます。
ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.sub.en: Paste in your notes. I pick out the next steps and put those with a date or someone waiting for them first.

ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.text: このページをブックマークしておくと、また戻ってこられます。いつでも {site}/home/cloud から入れます。
ja:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.en: Bookmark this page so you can come back. You can always return at {site}/home/cloud.

pt-br:gatewayBusy.repeated.title.text: {engine} keeps turning this request down. Your message is kept.
pt-br:gatewayBusy.repeated.title.en: {engine} keeps turning this request down. Your message is kept.
pt-br:gatewayBusy.repeated.title.note: Untranslated. Fix: {engine} continua recusando este pedido. Sua mensagem está salva.

pt-br:engine.toolLimit.notice.text: Algumas ferramentas foram omitidas neste turno: esta IA aceita no máximo {limit} ferramentas.
pt-br:engine.toolLimit.notice.en: Some tools were left out this turn: this AI accepts at most {limit} tools.

pt-br:engine.toolLimit.noRoom.text: Esta IA aceita no máximo {limit} ferramentas, o que não basta para {engine} funcionar no Murage. Escolha outro modelo.
pt-br:engine.toolLimit.noRoom.en: This AI accepts at most {limit} tools, which is not enough for {engine} to work in Murage. Choose another model.

pt-br:engine.toolLimit.catalogUnknown.text: O Murage não conseguiu confirmar a lista de ferramentas desta IA. A mensagem não foi enviada com um limite de ferramentas não verificado.
pt-br:engine.toolLimit.catalogUnknown.en: Murage could not confirm this AI's tool list. The message was not sent with an unverified tool budget.

pt-br:engine.toolLimit.catalogChanged.text: A lista de ferramentas mudou enquanto o Murage preparava este turno. O Murage não conseguiu ajustá-la ao limite desta IA.
pt-br:engine.toolLimit.catalogChanged.en: The tool list changed while Murage was preparing this turn. Murage could not fit it within this AI's limit.

pt-br:engine.submission.afterSubmission.text: A mensagem original foi enviada. O Murage não conseguiu enviá-la novamente porque as verificações de envio falharam. Ela não foi reenviada automaticamente.
pt-br:engine.submission.afterSubmission.en: The original message was submitted. Murage could not send it again because the submission checks failed. It was not automatically sent again.

pt-br:engine.submission.afterSubmissionU.text: O envio anterior pode ter começado. O Murage não conseguiu enviar a mensagem novamente porque as verificações de envio falharam. Ela não foi reenviada automaticamente.
pt-br:engine.submission.afterSubmissionU.en: The earlier submission may have started. Murage could not send it again because the submission checks failed. It was not automatically sent again.

pt-br:acp.defaultThinking.note: 'Padrão do mecanismo' is an unnatural, opaque label. Fix: Configuração padrão da IA

pt-br:ux.cloud.signin.notHere.text: Ainda não é possível entrar no {engine} pelo navegador. Use o app de computador do Murage.
pt-br:ux.cloud.signin.notHere.en: You can't sign in to {engine} from a browser yet. Use the Murage desktop app for it.

pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub.text: Toda manhã, uma página curta com o que precisa de você primeiro. Uso seu calendário e seu e-mail assim que você os conectar.
pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub.en: Each morning, I give you one short page of what needs your attention first. I use your calendar and email once you connect them.

pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub.text: Digite o que tem para hoje, uma linha por item. Eu digo qual vai atrasar e o que fazer primeiro.
pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub.en: Type in today's tasks, one per line. I tell you which task will run late and what to do first.

pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.sub.text: Cole suas anotações. Eu separo os próximos passos e coloco primeiro os que têm data ou alguém esperando.
pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.sub.en: Paste in your notes. I pick out the next steps and put those with a date or someone waiting for them first.

pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.text: Salve esta página nos favoritos para poder voltar. Em qualquer dia, {site}/home/cloud é a entrada.
pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.en: Bookmark this page so you can come back. You can always return at {site}/home/cloud.
pt-br:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.note: Unnatural wording introduces an unnecessary entrance metaphor. Fix: Salve esta página nos favoritos para poder voltar. Você pode voltar a qualquer momento em {site}/home/cloud.

zh:gatewayBusy.repeated.title.text: {engine} keeps turning this request down. Your message is kept.
zh:gatewayBusy.repeated.title.en: {engine} keeps turning this request down. Your message is kept.
zh:gatewayBusy.repeated.title.note: Untranslated. Fix: {engine} 一直拒绝这个请求。你的消息已保留。

zh:engine.toolLimit.notice.text: 本轮省略了部分工具：此 AI 最多接受 {limit} 个工具。
zh:engine.toolLimit.notice.en: Some tools were left out this turn: this AI accepts at most {limit} tools.

zh:engine.toolLimit.noRoom.text: 此 AI 最多接受 {limit} 个工具，不足以让 {engine} 在 Murage 中工作。请选择其他模型。
zh:engine.toolLimit.noRoom.en: This AI accepts at most {limit} tools, which is not enough for {engine} to work in Murage. Choose another model.

zh:engine.toolLimit.catalogUnknown.text: Murage 无法确认此 AI 的工具列表。工具数量限制未经验证，因此未发送消息。
zh:engine.toolLimit.catalogUnknown.en: Murage could not confirm this AI's tool list. The message was not sent with an unverified tool budget.

zh:engine.toolLimit.catalogChanged.text: Murage 准备本轮时，工具列表发生了变化。Murage 无法将其控制在此 AI 的限制内。
zh:engine.toolLimit.catalogChanged.en: The tool list changed while Murage was preparing this turn. Murage could not fit it within this AI's limit.

zh:engine.submission.afterSubmission.text: 原始消息已提交。由于提交检查失败，Murage 无法再次发送。该消息没有自动重发。
zh:engine.submission.afterSubmission.en: The original message was submitted. Murage could not send it again because the submission checks failed. It was not automatically sent again.

zh:engine.submission.afterSubmissionUnce.text: 之前的提交可能已开始。由于提交检查失败，Murage 无法再次发送。该消息没有自动重发。
zh:engine.submission.afterSubmissionUnce.en: The earlier submission may have started. Murage could not send it again because the submission checks failed. It was not automatically sent again.

zh:ux.cloud.terms.siteIntro.text: 你需要同意一次条款。请在 murage.ai 上同意，然后回到这里。
zh:ux.cloud.terms.siteIntro.en: You need to agree to the terms once. Agree on murage.ai, then come back here.

zh:ux.cloud.signin.notHere.text: 目前还不能在浏览器中登录 {engine}。请使用 Murage 桌面应用。
zh:ux.cloud.signin.notHere.en: You can't sign in to {engine} from a browser yet. Use the Murage desktop app for it.

zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub.text: 每天早上一页简短的内容，列出最先需要你处理的事。你连接日历和邮箱后，我会使用它们。
zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.brief.sub.en: Each morning, I give you one short page of what needs your attention first. I use your calendar and email once you connect them.

zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub.text: 输入今天要做的事，每行一件。我会告诉你哪一件会被耽搁，以及先做什么。
zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.day.sub.en: Type in today's tasks, one per line. I tell you which task will run late and what to do first.

zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.sub.text: 粘贴你的笔记。我会挑出下一步行动，并把有日期或有人在等的排在最前面。
zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.job.notes.sub.en: Paste in your notes. I pick out the next steps and put those with a date or someone waiting for them first.

zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.text: 把这个页面加入书签，方便你回来。任何一天，{site}/home/cloud 都是入口。
zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.en: Bookmark this page so you can come back. You can always return at {site}/home/cloud.
zh:ux.cloud.firstRun.bookmarkDoor.note: '任何一天' is a literal, unnatural rendering of 'always'. Fix: 把这个页面加入书签，方便你回来。你随时都可以通过 {site}/home/cloud 回来。
